facts: Parties: Northgate Systems Ltd (Buyer), Ingleby Retail Group plc (Seller); the Company is Hartwell Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 19 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 12 September 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 19 July 2026), either party may terminate.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 20 days of becoming aware of it.
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $5,000,000.
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,090,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $183,180,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 30 January 2027.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $5,300,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,500,000.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Larkspur Robotics Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
